thread:
Sam G: Quick check-in — proposed plan for 0.16 bump: staggered canary across regions and repos. Cutoff is tomorrow 09:00 PT. Thoughts?

Priya S: +1 to staggered. We'll wait for runtime canary tag before tagging API. Changelog ready in draft. PR: https://github.com/redwood/api/pull/501

Jon P: Runtime will push a canary tag `v0.16.0-canary.1` to us-west-2 and us-east-1 nodes. Still debugging a memory regression on long-context tests, but can run canary with reduced max-seq. PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/821

Maria L: I'll prioritize runtime review this morning. If the long-context regression persists, we can gate canary to us-east-1 only and keep us-west on previous stable.

release-bot: Reminder — merges to release/0.16 require 2 approvals and green CI. See policy: https://go/release-policy

Jonathan K: Console will accept a delayed bump — happy to publish per-region if needed. Who will own npm creds today? @Priya S?

Priya S: I can publish regionally. If we need a post-cut patch, we'll do a .1 quick follow-up.

DevEx Bot: SDK freeze scheduled 05:00 PT tomorrow. I'll open PRs with migration notes and per-region usage tips. Example snippet I'll include:
```
# js
npm install @redwood/sdk@0.16.0-canary.1
import {RedwoodClient}from '@redwood/sdk'
const c = new RedwoodClient({apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY})\n```

Sam G: Action items (staggered plan):
- Jon: push canary tag to us-east and us-west (or us-east only if regression persists)
- Maria: final runtime approvals and regression triage
- Priya: coordinate API tag after runtime canary is healthy
- Jonathan: regionally publish console or hold per-region publish as instructed
- DevEx: open SDK PRs + migration notes
Flag blockers by 03:30 PT so we can decide full vs staggered bump.

Jon P: Pushed canary `v0.16.0-canary.1` to us-east. Will slot us-west if the long-context test passes in the next run.

eng-sre-bot: If CI flakes appear, use `/incident create` and tag @eng-sre for a quick stub; we can escalate.

Maria L: Long-context test still failing on us-west runner — isolating a fixture mismatch. Approving canary on us-east only for now.

Priya S: Creating API tag `v0.16.0-canary.1` pointing at stable + api fixes; will hold main `v0.16.0` until us-west is green.

Jonathan K: Console e2e passed against us-east canary. I'll hold us-west publish pending green.

DevEx Bot: Opened SDK PRs with canary instructions:
- https://github.com/redwood/sdk-js/pull/231
- https://github.com/redwood/sdk-python/pull/128

Sam G: Thanks — plan sounds good. We'll reconvene 06:00 PT for final go/no-go on full rollout. Please ping here for any slips or if you need a staggered rollback signal.
